title: Finite Non-$p$-Groups with 5 Automorphism Orbits
summary: We obtain a characterization of finite non-$p$-groups with five automorphism orbits. In the solvable case of Fitting height $3$, the groups are precisely $S_4$ and $C_2^4\rtimes D_{10}$. Moreover, the corresponding fixed-point subspaces form a spread in a finite projective space. For Fitting height $2$, we distinguish the possible structures according to the number of prime divisors of $|G|$.
